failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_1: 'they contain no information about the author of "Love and Mr Lewisham," including their nationality or awards. To verify this claim, passages containing biographical information about the author of "Love and Mr Lewisham" would be necessary.' Summary_2 identifies 'H. G. Wells as the author of "Love and Mr Lewisham"' and the query in hop 3 explicitly targets 'H. G. Wells' but retrieval returns no biographical passage about H. G. Wells—only the novel description and unrelated Lewisham/Darío documents. The gap (H. G. Wells's nationality and awards) was named and chased but never filled.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Who is the author of "Love and Mr Lewisham" and what is their nationality?' Hop 3 query: 'H. G. Wells, Rubén Darío, Love and Mr Lewisham'. Both queries target the same information (author identity/nationality for Love and Mr Lewisham, and Rubén Darío). Hop 3 retrieval returns largely duplicate documents from hop 1 (Rubén Darío National Theatre, disambiguation, National Library, Madrid Metro, Velázquez, Rossi all repeat) plus the same 'Love and Mr Lewisham' passage from hop 2, indicating the queries failed to advance substantively.
